description: Defines classes for camera session and stream statistics, including CameraStreamStats and CameraSessionStats, with associated enums, constants, and parcel read/write methods.

classes.name: CameraStreamStats
classes.description: Holds statistics and info about a camera stream, including resolution, format, histogram data, and usage metrics.

classes.name: CameraSessionStats
classes.description: Contains session-wide camera statistics, including state, request counts, errors, and associated stream stats.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Reads object data from a Parcel.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Writes object data to a Parcel.
